newsitem.title: USA: SCB Computer buys Memphis company.
newsitem.headline: SCB Computer buys Memphis company.

text.p: SCB Computer Technology Inc said Monday it has reached a definitive agreement to buy Delta Software Systems Inc, an information technology consulting company and custom software programmer in Memphis, Tennessee.
In the tax-free merger, which is to be done as a pooling of interests, Delta will become a SCB subsidiary, and SCB will issue about $8.4 million in common shares to Delta shareholders.
SCB said it expects to issue about 461,500 shares, or about 6.6 percent of the currently outstanding SCB common, in the merger.
The deal is expected to close on or before September 30.
Delta had revenue of $6.6 million for its year ended December 31, 1995, SCB said.
SCB provides information technology management and technical services to state and local governments, public utilities and Fortune 500 companies.
